name: Hidayah - A Content Blocker
description: Replaces adult/pornographic pages with a calm full-page random verse of the Qur'an (Arabic, English translation, and recitation). A dignified pause, not a punishment screen.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.alquran.cloud; media-src 'self' https://cdn.islamic.network
